summary: 2 findings. A stale update can overwrite newer data; the same comparison already exists in the export path.

findings.bugClass: Compares the server's read revision instead of the client's submitted revision
findings.evidence: services/commerce/internal/store/store.go:42 compares the revision read during this request. store.go:88 repeats it in the batch update added by this change.
findings.impact: Concurrent edits can overwrite the user's newer value.
findings.correction: Compare with the revision submitted by the client at both locations.

findings.originEvidence: services/commerce/internal/store/export.go:17 at BASE_SHA has the same comparison; this change does not touch or call it.
findings.bugClass: Compares the server's read revision instead of the client's submitted revision
findings.evidence: services/commerce/internal/store/export.go:17 compares the revision read during the export request.
findings.impact: A concurrent edit can be exported with a stale revision number.
findings.correction: Compare with the revision submitted by the client.
